_comment: M2 fake_traceability mutant: this matrix LIES. Every constraint→design→test chain entry exists, but each cited test asserts an UNRELATED behavior (e.g. allergy-detection constraint → audit-log test; 50-registration-limit constraint → basic booking test). The Phase 2.5 trace-chain judge must read this and flag chain_truthful=false, dropping traceability_truthfulness. constraintDescriptions carry readable text so the judge can match gold obligations by SEMANTICS (gold uses C-001..C-004, the mutant cover-matrix uses C014/C016/etc — no direct id mapping).

constraintDescriptions.C001: 每位医生每日限号50个，同一患者同日同科限挂1次（挂号约束）
constraintDescriptions.C002: 单张处方药品种类不超过5种，抗生素需主任医师审核（处方约束）
constraintDescriptions.C003: 过期药品不可发出，库存不足不可开方，麻醉药品需双签（药品约束）
constraintDescriptions.C004: 已发药品不可退费（特殊审批除外），检查已做不可退费（退费约束）
constraintDescriptions.X002: 开方时自动拦截过敏药品（过敏检测）
constraintDescriptions.X005: 收费系统故障时缓存交易记录并恢复后同步（收费系统故障）
